title: AI for Social Good Fellowship
description: Supports early-career researchers applying machine learning to healthcare, education, or environmental challenges in India.

title: National NLP Research Grant
description: Funding for research advancing natural language processing, especially for low-resource Indian languages.

title: Cybersecurity Innovation Grant
description: Supports research in cybersecurity, threat detection, and AI system security including adversarial robustness.

title: Robotics & Autonomous Systems Fund
description: Funding for robotics research including control systems, autonomous navigation, and hardware prototyping.

title: Climate Resilience Research Grant
description: Supports climate modeling, environmental monitoring, and water resource management research.

title: Biomedical AI Research Award
description: Funding for applying AI and machine learning to genomics, protein research, and medical diagnostics.

title: Renewable Energy Innovation Grant
funder: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
description: Supports research in solar energy, materials science, and smart grid technology.

title: Quantum Technologies Fellowship
description: Funding for research in quantum computing, quantum cryptography, and quantum materials.

title: Fintech & Fraud Detection Research Grant
description: Supports research in financial technology, fraud detection, and behavioral analytics for BFSI applications.

title: Public Health Data Science Grant
description: Funding for epidemiological research, disease surveillance, and public health data analysis.

title: Autonomous Vehicles & Drone Tech Grant
description: Supports research in drone technology, autonomous navigation, and computer vision for unmanned systems.

title: Explainable AI Research Fellowship
description: Funding for interpretability and explainability research across NLP and computer vision models.

title: Distributed Systems & Cloud Research Grant
description: Supports research in distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and blockchain consensus algorithms.

title: Early Career Interdisciplinary Grant
description: Open funding for early-career researchers across all disciplines pursuing novel interdisciplinary work.

title: Faculty Research Excellence Award
description: Funding for established faculty pursuing high-impact original research in any STEM field.
